r.notes: Rare sighting of a Koala in my neighbour's garden, however it is likely that they frequent the area
He looked thirsty or trying to find something
Was on the ground and climbed the tree to about 20ft. Then just observed me - it was very alert and looked healthy
Koala moves around the area, neighbours see it quite often.
screeching alerted us to its presence and eyes in the torchlight identified his location high up in one of next doors gum - pretty sure its a male
A female with significant cystitis - sad face
have heard and seen a few in recent weeks.
I think was about to change trees before I disturbed it - so she (I think) headed back up
a large male - grunting in the night, making us aware of his presence

this little female has Cystitis. Koala Care group assisted in capturing her and hopefully she'll be cared back to full health.  Grunting 50 meters away was a large male who was probably disappointed she was taken.
A female in a gum near a creekline.  there is a thin strip of gums in this semi rural area connected to larger forests. Female looks like she may have Cystitis
Heard at 5.30 am found sleeping that afternoon high in a gum tree in our backyard
honoured to have this visitor in the back yard
This is Boris - assuming its the same one that the neighbours kids named.  seems to be his stomping ground in our back yard. arent we have lucky
mid morning crossing a small track in a popular bush walking area - next to a large dam.
